name: konsole-tabs
description: Name and colour the Konsole tab of a Claude Code session: restore on resume, optional auto-pick from the first prompt

auto_mode.title: Auto name and colour
auto_mode.description: Pick a short tab name and a colour by task type from the first prompt (runs a small haiku call in the background)

auto_attempts.title: Auto attempts per session
auto_attempts.description: How many times auto mode may try to pick a name and colour in one session when a try fails (no network, login error). 1 = no retry
